title: Biological detail does not guarantee portability of colorectal cancer metagenomic classifiers
description: Code, processed data, profiles, and per-sample predictions for a prospective portability stress test across ten colorectal-cancer development cohorts and an untouched 200-sample external cohort. Compares species, pathways, gene families, frozen mechanisms, correction strategies, and label-free performance-risk signals under country-aware held-out-study evaluation.
